scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate --if-present && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
